text:
jordan: Pushed prod rollout v1.12.3 at 09:22 PT. This thread is for a quick post-deploy lite scan (20m). Canary was in us-east-1 (5% -> 100%). Please do the minimum checks below and report back: health endpoint, p95 latency, error-rate, any obvious logs for tokenization/decoder errors. If error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m, rollback. Notify here if you spot anything weird. I'll coordinate fallback if needed.

maya: On it — watching metrics + dashboard. I can run the smoke suite in ~5m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment complete — service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v1.12.3 rollout=100% region=us-east-1 duration=3m12s.

sam: Ran quick health probe, all good: /health -> 200. K8s pods READY=6/6. Quick curl I used: 
```
curl -sS -D - http://inference-api.prod.internal/health | head -n 1
```
returns HTTP/1.1 200 OK.

alex: Spinning up a batch of 20 synthetic prompts to check latency and tokenization. p95 baseline looks ~80ms; seeing p95 ~120ms right after rollout (warmup). No errors in first 50 requests.

lia: Heads-up — small uptick in tokenization errors for long-context (>2048) tests, error counter +0.7% over last 3m, traced to tokenizer-service timeouts for 1 request in logs. Posting sample log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-17T16:28:49Z] tokenizer timeout: request_id=abc123 seq_len=3072 route=/v1/generate
```

sam: I found a deployment env var mismatch — MAX_SEQ was unset in the new chart, defaulting to 2048. Opened a quick infra PR to set MAX_SEQ=4096 for prod canary: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 — applying hotfix to canary now.

jordan: Good catch. If the tokenizer timeouts don't drop below 0.5% after the fix and one more minute, we should rollback. @alex can you re-run the long-context batch after the fix? @maya keep an eye on p95 and error-rate dashboard.

alex: Re-running long-context batch now against the canary with the env var patched. First 20 requests: tokenization errors dropped to 0/20. p95 back to ~85ms.

deploy-bot: canary-check: canary_health=PASS error_rate_5m=0.6% latency_p95=95ms region=us-east-1

maya: Console looks stable, no alerts firing. I'm keeping the runbook open for 10 more minutes then marking post-deploy as ok. :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks team. Leaving rollout at 100%. Filing a follow-up for adding an automated long-context synthetic test to nightly job (INF-344). I'll update the release checklist and close this thread once the 20m window finishes.

sam: Added note in release notes about MAX_SEQ env and the hotfix.

alex: LGTM, no further action from infra side.

lia: Monitoring for another 10m then will clear the alert if it stays steady.

jordan: Closing in 10. Great job rapid triage — saved a rollback. :tada:
